summary: This note is a short wiki-style biography of Bill Goldberg, focusing on his amateur and early professional football career. It states he played college football at the University of Georgia as a defensive tackle on a scholarship. It also records that the Los Angeles Rams drafted him in the 11th round of the 1990 NFL draft.
